description: Four-chip header strip summarising deployment complexity: binding constraint label, friction-observation count, regulatory-anchor count, and AES classification. Cross-substrate — reads workshopContext, manifest, and charter.

fieldDependencies.displayAs: Chip 1 — '1 · <label>' in teal accent. Shows '—' when absent.
Chip 2 — '<n> observations' with count in teal accent. Shows '—' when absent.
fieldDependencies.note: CANONICAL PATH. The D-137 spec listed charter.provenance.derivedFrom.derivedFromFrictionIds[] as the source primitive, but the actual FMT charter v1.3.1 (exports/fmt-credit-writeup-v1.3.1/charter.jsonld) does not have this field. provenance.derivedFrom contains 'decisions[]' and 'enrichmentEvidenceBasis[]' only. The correct runtime path is manifest.userStories.derivedFromFrictionIds[] — identical to bundle_metric_strip. Widget also checks charter.provenance.derivedFrom.derivedFromFrictionIds as a fallback for future substrates that may populate it.

fieldDependencies.displayAs: Chip 2 fallback path (spec-declared but absent in v1.3.1 charter). Used only if manifest path is absent.
fieldDependencies.note: FALLBACK PATH ONLY. Not present in FMT charter v1.3.1. Retained for forward-compatibility if substrate is updated to populate this field.

fieldDependencies.displayAs: Chip 3 — '<n> anchors' with count in teal accent. Reads array length. Shows '—' when absent.
Chip 4 — AES classification string in teal accent (e.g. 'hitl_assisted'). Top-level charter field confirmed in FMT charter v1.3.1. Shows '—' when absent.
fieldDependencies.note: CONFIRMED PATH. charter.aesClassification is a top-level string field in the FMT charter v1.3.1 (value: 'hitl_assisted'). The spec listed it as 'charter.aesClassification' — this matches exactly.
